agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario violates controller_force_limit at step 14: controller force 579.9 exceeds fmax 11.35. Steps 12-13 show force correctly clamped at fmax while body 1 accelerates to ~50 m/s toward waypoint (18.1,10.8). At step 14 body 1 is near waypoint (distance <1m) with large velocity error (speed 50.25 vs vcmd 12.43), so kp*velocity_error ≈ 12*~38 = ~460+; controller computes raw force without clamping to fmax, likely due to missing clamp after collision/ substep impulse scaling (substeps_in_step jumps from 1 to 55). Disabling controller removes violation, proving clamp logic is at fault.
